concept.description: Labels controller methods carrying a request mapping as :Endpoint (httpMethod, fullPath = class mapping + method mapping).
concept.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(at:Type) WHERE at.fqn IN ['org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping', 'org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping', 'org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping', 'org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping', 'org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping', 'org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PatchMapping'] AND EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(ax:Type) WHERE ax.fqn IN ['org.springframework.stereotype.Controller', 'org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController'] } OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS]->(:Value {name: 'value'})-[:CONTAINS]->(mp:Value) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(ca:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(:Type {fqn: 'org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (ca)-[:HAS]->(:Value {name: 'value'})-[:CONTAINS]->(cp:Value) WITH m, at, head(collect(DISTINCT mp.value)) AS methodPath, head(collect(DISTINCT cp.value)) AS classPath SET m:Endpoint, m.httpMethod = toUpper(replace(at.name, 'Mapping', '')), m.fullPath = coalesce(classPath, '') + coalesce(methodPath, '') RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS Endpoints

MATCH (lt:Type {fqn: 'org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.SseEmitter'})-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = 'send' SET m:SideEffectCall RETURN count(m) AS Labelled

constraint.description: Several @ControllerAdvice classes need an explicit @Order, otherwise exception-handler selection is undefined.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(ax:Type) WHERE ax.fqn IN ['org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ControllerAdvice', 'org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice'] } WITH collect(DISTINCT t) AS advices WHERE size(advices) > 1 UNWIND advices AS t WITH t WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(ax:Type) WHERE ax.fqn IN ['org.springframework.core.annotation.Order', 'org.springframework.core.Ordered'] } RETURN t AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, 'multiple @ControllerAdvice without @Order' AS Detail

constraint.description: Endpoints exchanging byte[] load whole payloads in memory: stream them (InputStreamResource / StreamingResponseBody).
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method:Endpoint) WHERE NOT t:Test AND (m.signature STARTS WITH 'byte[] ' OR m.signature CONTAINS '(byte[]' OR m.signature CONTAINS ',byte[]') RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, m.signature AS Detail

constraint.description: Cookies created in code must be marked HttpOnly (and Secure).
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(c:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(ct:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND ct.fqn IN ['jakarta.servlet.http.Cookie', 'javax.servlet.http.Cookie'] AND coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = '<init>' AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (m)-[:INVOKES]->(s:Method) WHERE coalesce(s.name, last(split(split(s.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = 'setHttpOnly' } RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, 'Cookie created without setHttpOnly' AS Detail
